title: Biggest Explosion on JBLM in over a Decade
description: U.S. Army combat engineers assigned to B Company, 23rd Brigade Engineer Battalion, 1-2 Stryker Brigade Combat Team, 7th Infantry Division, conduct heavy demolition training at Joint Base Lewis-McChord, Washington, Sept. 13, 2023. The training consisted of confidence charges, demolition area clearance, urban breaching, bangalore shots on concertina wire obstacles, shaped charges, and cratering charges. The result was the biggest explosion on JBLM in over a decade by using the shaped and cratering charges. (U.S. Army video by Pfc. Elijah Magana)
keywords: demolition, Essayons, jblm, U.S.Army, 12B Combat Engineer, 7ID
